title: Cyclic class detection by discrete integral restriction
statement: For prime l, any scheme Y and n, the exact-functor Ext map induced by diagonalFiniteToPadic l n on GeoCartierClass over diagonalResidue l n and diagonalImmersion Y is injective.

proof.text: Construct the identity-on-sections natural isomorphism from ordinary abelian forgetting to finite restriction followed by discrete integral forgetting. Exact-functor composition coherence shows equality after restriction implies equality of the two abelian Ext images after postcomposing this isomorphism. Postcomposition by an isomorphism is injective. Compose the resulting equality with cartierProIntegralGenerator and use its existing supported integral-generator Ext bijection.

theorem diagonalCyclicClass_restrict_injective
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (fun c : GeoCartierClass (diagonalResidue.{u} l n)
        (l ^ (n + 1)) (cartierResidue_cast l (n + 1)) (diagonalImmersion Y) ↦
      c.mapExactFunctor (diagonalFiniteToPadic l n (diagonalSurface Y)))
